title: SpaceX wins a property tax exemption for its planned $55B Terafab chip facility in Texas, despite Texans threatening legal action, amid local opposition to AI (Stephanie Findlay/Financial Times)
summary: Stephanie Findlay / Financial Times: SpaceX wins a property tax exemption for its planned $55B Terafab chip facility in Texas, despite Texans threatening legal action, amid local opposition to AI — Elon Musk's Terafab plant sparks fierce opposition and threat of legal action from residents of Texas county
